Hot Sausage Sandwich
By: Matt Randall
Published: Sunday, April 10, 2011 - 5:52am

Ingredients




Italian sausage
Italian bread
Provolone cheese
Marinara sauce

Preparation

1 Pre heat your oven to 350 degrees.  Brown your Italian sausage and cut into bite size pieces.  Take two pieces of Italian bread and add a slice of provolone cheese to each slice.  Add the sausage pieces and a heaping spoon of marinara sauce to the one slice of bread.  Place the other slice of bread on top.  Bake for 10 minutes and enjoy.
